review_scope: Source-level adversarial review of six distinguishability production modules and cross-check of the frozen contract interfaces. The reviewing agent implemented the six experiment modules; the numerical regret, native bridge, original GI, and final publication are owned by other agents. This is not an independent third-party re-derivation of all Lean code or an attestation of a future release.
formal_build_status: All six listed experiment module identities passed the coordinator's Mac Lean build, including the final Sharp arbitrary-private-probability-space bridge. For actual logs, time, trust dependencies and publication identity use the coordinator's build/axiom/manifests.

adversarial_checks.attack: Use a different adaptive table or seed after inspecting the mechanism; match paths only on the maximizing experiment.
adversarial_checks.why: history_three_eq_unless_NFN quantifies over every Table and every primitive tape under the actual recursive execute. commonInput factors the same seed/table and noise laws before choosing a fixed start world. raw_H3_TV_upper quantifies over arbitrary-memory real action kernels even without a legality restriction. No maximizing policy is assumed in the upper bound.

adversarial_checks.attack: Use an unobservable mechanism tag, birth label, or parent as a controller coin; count only tapes of one hidden label.
adversarial_checks.why: Actions at each table node depend on own earlier actions/receipts via the table traversal; seededLaw exposes only own seed and controller history. Both labels are included in primitiveLaw, tapeLaw and modeWord_mass; primitiveLaw_ofParameters identifies the planning source at any registered rational rate. Native world retains records and hides them from the controller.

adversarial_checks.attack: Restrict stochastic controls to rational weights, finite memory, or independent fresh uniform choices at each actual decision.
adversarial_checks.why: Each original real causal policy has a common finite contingent-table PMF with identical allowed-history law for every world. Positive original actions and reachable receipt branches transfer supported legality. Any law on complete tables allows arbitrary correlation in an independent ex-ante private source. At fixed finite H the table space is finite; real weights are unrestricted.

adversarial_checks.attack: Forget the private seed at terminal classification or assume a nonatomic randomizer must have finitely many atoms.
adversarial_checks.why: For finite seeds the actual seed is already included in the classified output. For an arbitrary probability measure on Seed (including a nonatomic law), fix all private inputs including any terminal coin; each seed determines its own action tree AND its own terminal event. privateTestRisk averages the actual conditional binary risk against the same seed distribution and independent physical tape. The lower-integral formulation covers every measurable implementation without a separate integrability premise.

adversarial_checks.attack: Use complete hidden Store equality to infer root-only indistinguishability; require unused table rows to dispatch only root.
adversarial_checks.why: SameRoot uses the root bit and stop status only; the path-level theorem accepts root dispatch along the positive S execution, not on unreachable rows. Full hidden tails may differ after global damage.

adversarial_checks.attack: Underpay a write that fails on a fault, or normalize an impossible short-budget observation.
adversarial_checks.why: PrepaidHistory checks the request cap before subtracting the receipt charge. A damaged founder and B<c disallow every write; supported shared experiments have the same all-00 receipts. Joint posterior divides only at strictly positive evidence; zero mass still satisfies the unnormalized identity.

adversarial_checks.attack: A fixed-word difference alone proves optimum TV; the all-fault equality entails positive decision regret.
adversarial_checks.why: TV upper is event-limited shared-noise coupling over all contingent choices; actual charged one-write protocol obtains an exclusive event of exactly r²(1-r). Fixed-goal H3 uses the discrepancy only on tick 3, not for a later action. All-fault classification overlap (1-r)^H gives a separate binary-error bound, not regret. Regret lower comes instead from Bayes full-class upper at w=(3/4,1/4).

adversarial_checks.attack: A zero short-history TV boundary prevents all useful action; identify the mechanism before planning.
adversarial_checks.why: For all registered rational planning parameters H≤2, old solve at known S returns a table feasible at either model under the same wallet. The actual source value coincides and dominates the original full real causal class; frozen H=2 attains 13/16, strictly positive.

adversarial_checks.attack: Change the model every tick or use a defect in old observer to unfreeze prior PR442 conclusions.
adversarial_checks.why: theta_preserved keeps m for the entire run. The only new world change is post-local-transaction G fault damage, even at missing addresses or stop. In the real 11/00 history child1 differs while mechanism likelihood r(1-r) agrees; the old singleton observer remains valid only on its previous local source.

adversarial_checks.attack: Claim all-policy minimax from a two-by-two payoff matrix, or claim expected payment is sufficient at each prefix.
adversarial_checks.why: The regret code proves all_shared_weighted_upper via original rawValue_le_solve for dual prior metadata; the actual deployed controller does not inspect a true prior. every_raw_has_shared_realization preserves both actual mechanism J values. The 1/32 lattice covers arbitrary deterministic contingent responses. NativePrepaid checks literal request before actual native fee and returned_native_payment holds for each seed and full tape.

scope_boundaries: Root-only equality is a law of permitted receipts/actions, not hidden Store equality.
The zero-budget boundary requires damaged initialization and actual request cap; it does not cover healthy initial backup or a new free repair action.

TV symbolic result is for a fixed common real r in [0,1] and independent physical ticks. Planning source parameters remain rational; the H3 main consumer is exact r=1/2. No additional finite rate mixture was implemented or claimed.
The using-H3 classifier chooses G when no exclusive event appears only as an optimal binary decision under registered equal test weights. It does not certify G or exhaust natural mechanisms.
The finite all-fault error bound is not a payoff or regret lower bound. The W witness is not a claim that 3/4 is nature's prior.
No N>3 learning-after-separation benefit, infinite-horizon identifiability, internal random hardware, or natural empirical support. Empirical scope UNVERIFIED.
